experiment: One DD-native optimizer step on a single orbit-source/fixed-center MultiCamWarp pair, then native inference on real case15 C with identical effective inputs, Stage2 endpoint, prompt and initial noise; checkpoint only changed.
holistic_visual_review: Dense source/official/adapted nine-time contact plus all 17 adapted frames: new checkpoint looks nearly identical to official. Both progressively fade and fail to reproduce the source right-arm sweep; generated pose stays close to its starting configuration. The 0.484->0.476 limb-error change is tiny and does not establish perceptual or action improvement.
caveat: One fixed-view synthetic scene with 4x upsampled depth and one optimizer step cannot establish training benefit or generalization; inspect all 17 frames and use held-out multi-scene training before judging adapter direction.
next_data_requirement: Fixed target alone is insufficient: this pair has zero source-target angle at f0, whereas real Stage3 already starts at a novel target angle. Need synchronized fixed multi-camera dance data with actual novel-view target and reliable source depth, split by dance/subject for held-out tests.
